import requests, json, numpy as np
from scipy import stats
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt, matplotlib.patches as mp2

rawm="""A R N D C Q E G H I L K M F P S T W Y V
A 4 -1 -2 -2 0 -1 -1 0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1 1 0 -3 -2 0
R -1 5 0 -2 -3 1 0 -2 0 -3 -2 2 -1 -3 -2 -1 -1 -3 -2 -3
N -2 0 6 1 -3 0 0 0 1 -3 -3 0 -2 -3 -2 1 0 -4 -2 -3
D -2 -2 1 6 -3 0 2 -1 -1 -3 -4 -1 -3 -3 -1 0 -1 -4 -3 -3
C 0 -3 -3 -3 9 -3 -4 -3 -3 -1 -1 -3 -1 -2 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1
Q -1 1 0 0 -3 5 2 -2 0 -3 -2 1 0 -3 -1 0 -1 -2 -1 -2
E -1 0 0 2 -4 2 5 -2 0 -3 -3 1 -2 -3 -1 0 -1 -3 -2 -2
G 0 -2 0 -1 -3 -2 -2 6 -2 -4 -4 -2 -3 -3 -2 0 -2 -2 -3 -3
H -2 0 1 -1 -3 0 0 -2 8 -3 -3 -1 -2 -1 -2 -1 -2 -2 2 -3
I -1 -3 -3 -3 -1 -3 -3 -4 -3 4 2 -3 1 0 -3 -2 -1 -3 -1 3
L -1 -2 -3 -4 -1 -2 -3 -4 -3 2 4 -2 2 0 -3 -2 -1 -2 -1 1
K -1 2 0 -1 -3 1 1 -2 -1 -3 -2 5 -1 -3 -1 0 -1 -3 -2 -2
M -1 -1 -2 -3 -1 0 -2 -3 -2 1 2 -1 5 0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 1
F -2 -3 -3 -3 -2 -3 -3 -3 -1 0 0 -3 0 6 -4 -2 -2 1 3 -1
P -1 -2 -2 -1 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3 -1 -2 -4 7 -1 -1 -4 -3 -2
S 1 -1 1 0 -1 0 0 0 -1 -2 -2 0 -1 -2 -1 4 1 -3 -2 -2
T 0 -1 0 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1 1 5 -2 -2 0
W -3 -3 -4 -4 -2 -2 -3 -2 -2 -3 -2 -3 -1 1 -4 -3 -2 11 2 -3
Y -2 -2 -2 -3 -2 -1 -2 -3 2 -1 -1 -2 -1 3 -3 -2 -2 2 7 -1
V 0 -3 -3 -3 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3 3 1 -2 1 -2 -2 -2 0 -3 -1 4"""
ls=rawm.strip().split("\n"); cols=ls[0].split(); idx={a:i for i,a in enumerate(cols)}
Mx=np.full((25,25),-4.0)
for l in ls[1:]:
    p=l.split()
    for c,v in zip(cols,p[1:]): Mx[idx[p[0]],idx[c]]=float(v)
def enc(s): return np.array([idx.get(c,20) for c in s])
def nw_np(s1,s2,go=-11.0,ge=-1.0):
    e1,e2=enc(s1),enc(s2); n,m=len(e1),len(e2); NEG=-1e9
    M=np.full(m+1,NEG);X=np.full(m+1,NEG);Y=np.full(m+1,NEG)
    tb=np.zeros((n+1,m+1,3),dtype=np.int8); M[0]=0.0
    for j in range(1,m+1): Y[j]=go+ge*(j-1); tb[0,j,2]=2
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        pM,pX,pY=M,X,Y
        M=np.full(m+1,NEG);X=np.full(m+1,NEG);Y=np.full(m+1,NEG)
        X[0]=go+ge*(i-1); tb[i,0,1]=1
        row=Mx[e1[i-1]][e2]
        d=np.stack([pM[:-1],pX[:-1],pY[:-1]]); k=d.argmax(0); M[1:]=d[k,np.arange(m)]+row; tb[i,1:,0]=k
        d2=np.stack([pM[1:]+go,pX[1:]+ge,pY[1:]+go]); k2=d2.argmax(0); X[1:]=d2[k2,np.arange(m)]; tb[i,1:,1]=k2
        for j in range(1,m+1):
            o=(M[j-1]+go,X[j-1]+go,Y[j-1]+ge); kk=int(np.argmax(o)); Y[j]=o[kk]; tb[i,j,2]=kk
    i,j=n,m; st=int(np.argmax([M[m],X[m],Y[m]])); a1=[];a2=[]
    while i>0 or j>0:
        if st==0: a1.append(s1[i-1]); a2.append(s2[j-1]); ns=tb[i,j,0]; i-=1; j-=1
        elif st==1: a1.append(s1[i-1]); a2.append("-"); ns=tb[i,j,1]; i-=1
        else: a1.append("-"); a2.append(s2[j-1]); ns=tb[i,j,2]; j-=1
        if i==0 and j>0: st=2; continue
        if j==0 and i>0: st=1; continue
        st=int(ns)
    return "".join(a1[::-1]),"".join(a2[::-1])

r=requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/stream",
   params={"query":"(gene:UMAD1) AND (taxonomy_id:7742)","format":"json",
           "fields":"accession,organism_name,sequence"},timeout=240)
recs=[dict(acc=d["primaryAccession"],org=d["organism"]["scientificName"],
           seq=d["sequence"]["value"],L=len(d["sequence"]["value"])) for d in r.json()["results"]]
HUM="".join(requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/C9J7I0.fasta",timeout=60).text.split("\n")[1:])
best={}
for x in recs:
    if not (110<=x["L"]<=175) or x["seq"]==HUM: continue
    if x["org"] not in best or abs(x["L"]-137)<abs(best[x["org"]]["L"]-137): best[x["org"]]=x
sel=sorted(best.values(),key=lambda z:z["org"])
step=max(1,len(sel)//150); sel=sel[::step][:150]
print(f"UniProt vertebrate UMAD1 entries: {len(recs)}; species retained after filtering: {len(sel)}")

idmat=[]
for s in sel:
    a,b=nw_np(HUM,s["seq"]); i=0; v=np.zeros(len(HUM))
    for x,y in zip(a,b):
        if x!="-":
            i+=1; v[i-1]=1.0 if x==y else 0.0
    idmat.append(v)
idmat=np.array(idmat); cons=idmat.mean(0); n_ok=len(idmat)
print(f"aligned {n_ok} orthologs; mean global identity to human {100*idmat.mean():.1f}%")

IFACE_U=[76,77,78,79,80,81,82,83,85,86,87,88,89,90,91,92,93,94]
UMA=list(range(86,135))
bg_all=[x for x in range(1,138) if x not in IFACE_U]
bg_uma=[x for x in UMA if x not in IFACE_U]
A=cons[[x-1 for x in IFACE_U]]; Ball=cons[[x-1 for x in bg_all]]; Buma=cons[[x-1 for x in bg_uma]]
U1,p1=stats.mannwhitneyu(A,Ball,alternative="greater")
U2,p2=stats.mannwhitneyu(A,Buma,alternative="greater")
print(f"\nPer-site identity across {n_ok} vertebrate UMAD1 orthologs:")
print(f"  predicted ESCRT-I contact face (n={len(A)}): {A.mean():.3f} +/- {A.std():.3f}")
print(f"  rest of protein (n={len(Ball)}):             {Ball.mean():.3f} +/- {Ball.std():.3f}  MWU p={p1:.2e} CLES={U1/(len(A)*len(Ball)):.2f}")
print(f"  rest of UMA 86-134 (n={len(Buma)}):          {Buma.mean():.3f} +/- {Buma.std():.3f}  MWU p={p2:.3f} CLES={U2/(len(A)*len(Buma)):.2f}")
print("  anchor residues:", {f"{HUM[x-1]}{x}":round(float(cons[x-1]),3) for x in [81,82,86,87,88,89,90,91,92,93]})
inv=[x for x in range(1,138) if cons[x-1]==1.0]
print(f"  invariant in all {n_ok} orthologs (n={len(inv)}): "+", ".join(f"{HUM[x-1]}{x}" for x in inv))

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(15,4.3))
colr=["#c0392b" if x in IFACE_U else ("#e67e22" if x in UMA else "#95a5a6") for x in range(1,138)]
ax.bar(range(1,138),cons,color=colr,width=0.9)
ax.axhline(cons.mean(),ls="--",color="k",lw=1); ax.text(2,cons.mean()+0.02,f"protein mean {cons.mean():.2f}",fontsize=9)
ax.set_xlabel("UMAD1 residue"); ax.set_ylabel(f"identity to human across\n{n_ok} vertebrate orthologs")
ax.set_xlim(0,138); ax.set_ylim(0,1.06)
ax.legend(handles=[mp2.Patch(color="#c0392b",label="predicted ESCRT-I contact face (mapped from PDB 6VME)"),
                   mp2.Patch(color="#e67e22",label="rest of UMA domain 86-134"),
                   mp2.Patch(color="#95a5a6",label="rest of protein")],fontsize=8,loc="upper left")
ax.set_title("Vertebrate conservation of UMAD1 by residue",fontsize=11)
for x in [89,90,91,92,93]: ax.text(x,cons[x-1]+0.015,HUM[x-1],ha="center",fontsize=8)
plt.show()
